import json,urllib.request

    r=urllib.request.Request('http://localhost:8080'+p,headers={'xc-token':TOK}); return json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=120))
rows=[];off=0
while True:
    js=g('/api/v2/tables/m58xsjo6at01ohl/records?limit=200&offset=%d'%off); rows+=js.get('list',[])

for r in rows:
    f=r.get('Файли')

        try: f=json.loads(f)
        except Exception: f=[]

        n+=1
        if len(names)<20: names.append('%s/%s'%(r.get('Угода'), (a.get('title') or '')[:40]))
